subject.why: The object is clearly a sturdy shovel with a red handle, complete with blade, shaft, and grip, as well as the requested falling sand.

category.why: The shovel floats freely with a dynamic tilt against a bright sunburst pattern background, with no surface or ground plane.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The shovel is centrally placed with generous margins around all edges.

colour.why: Bright and saturated yellow-orange background with strong contrast against the red handle, silver metal scoop, and sand.

detail.why: The sand is represented as chunky, smooth shapes rather than noisy granular micro-particles, keeping the object clean and readable.

style.why: The 3D render features smooth, chunky volumes and a soft satin sheen that perfectly matches the reference cards.
